title: Set up Push notifications - Hellotext
pageText:
D
Connect your storefront to Push
Storefront URL

Use the HTTPS address, such as https://store.example.com, without a path, query, or fragment.

Back
Continue

Shopify and VTEX set up Push automatically. Connect your store through its Hellotext integration and complete the storefront installation. You do not need to upload a service worker file or initialize Hellotext.js yourself. Then follow the guide to add subscription controls and verify your setup.
